description: Card surface. Element only: there is no data-layout or data-card attribute form; for a surface on a semantic element use data-canvas, for collections use <card-list>. A plain padded block by default; a header / section / footer child (or slot="header|content|footer") switches it to structured mode: header pinned on top, footer pinned at the bottom, every other child stacked between in source order. Surface elements use bare data-* attributes.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: Visual style: elevated (shadow), outlined (border), ghost (no surface).

attributes.name: data-padding
attributes.description: Internal padding. Block mode pads the card by the token (none/s/m/l/xl). Structured mode pads the children one step up: header/footer --size-m/--size-l and content --size-l at the default m (s: xs/s and s; l: l/xl and xl; xl: xl/2xl and 2xl); none also drops the header/footer dividers.

attributes.name: data-max
attributes.description: Max inline size, centered (margin-inline: auto in block flow, align-self in flex/grid): --content-narrow / --content-normal / --content-wide, or prose (65ch). Same keyword set as layout-center and canvas.

structure.description: Structured mode: pinned to the top, padded, with a bottom divider. A direct h1-h6 inside loses its margin and uses --font-size-l.
Structured mode: a content child. Every child that is not the header or footer is content and stacks in source order, one body padding apart.
Structured mode: pinned to the bottom (margin-block-start: auto), top divider, wrapping flex row of actions aligned to the inline end.
Any element treated as the header (also triggers structured mode).
Any element treated as content (also triggers structured mode, so a slot-only card works).
Any element treated as the footer (also triggers structured mode).
